notes.title: Update version 0.14.2 released
notes.notes:
Hello, I am pleased to announce the release of the new update version 0.14.2 :

- Added a small trailer on Steam of some features available in the game

- Added visual indicator to help the player

- Fixed using certain models for cleaning/repair tables

- Fixed cleaning/repair tables, after cleaning/repairing an object you could enter the tables but no longer exit them.

- Added the ability to exit the repair and cleaning tables with the Esc key


Thanks for the feedback I've received. If you have any suggestions or encounter any problems, please feel free to contact me.
